scope: Visual mockup revision only; no application code changes
requirements: No white content cards, including the profile identity block and expanded menu groups
Plain icons and text directly on the healthcare background
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: refined revision of the provided Asinu personal-page mobile UI mockup, portrait screen, same size and visual quality.
The reference image is the design to revise. Preserve its existing Asinu light mint healthcare wallpaper, mascot identity, overall typography, actual avatar and name, Vietnamese language, and bottom navigation. Text must stay perfectly sharp and correctly accented.
Primary revision: remove EVERY WHITE CONTENT CARD. The user wants simple Facebook-style icon and text menus directly on the healthcare background. There must be NO white group box, NO white individual button card, NO white rounded profile identity card, NO white strip behind any submenu, and NO menu shadows. The bottom navigation bar may remain white because it is navigation, not a content card.
Replace the top white identity card with the same circular avatar, "Dương Anh Đức", green dot and "Đang hoạt động", and "Tài khoản: Free" placed directly on the quiet pale healthcare background. No enclosing panel or pill.
Demonstrate that the OTHER accordion groups also have no cards by changing the visible open states:
"Thông tin cá nhân" collapsed with down chevron.
"Thao tác" collapsed with down chevron.
"Sức khỏe" collapsed with down chevron.
"Tài khoản" EXPANDED with up chevron, followed by two flat child actions:
  star outline icon, "Mở khoá chăm sóc nâng cao", right chevron;
  wallet outline icon, "Ví tiền", right chevron.
"Cài đặt" EXPANDED with up chevron, followed by two flat child actions:
  text-size outline icon, "Cỡ chữ ứng dụng", smaller value "Bình thường", right chevron;
  language outline icon, "Ngôn ngữ", smaller value "Tiếng Việt", right chevron.
"Hệ thống" collapsed with down chevron.
Then the plain red icon and text action "Đăng xuất".
IMPORTANT child hierarchy: indent each child row's icon and label to the RIGHT by about 20–24pt relative to the parent row alignment. All four children remain directly on exactly the SAME BACKGROUND as the page, no white surface underneath, no border, no rounded rectangle. Align child right chevrons to the same right edge as parent chevrons; values remain readable without running into labels. Parent rows use a slightly heavier text weight than children.
Keep generous but practical tap-row spacing and readable 16–18pt equivalent type. Use only a few low-contrast healthcare decorations around the edges, leaving the entire menu reading zone clear. The mascot and small ASINU wordmark may remain at the bottom near the tab bar without overlapping any words.
Bottom tabs remain "Trang chủ", "Kết nối", "Tổng quan", "Cá nhân", with only "Cá nhân" active in teal.
No additional page heading, no marketing copy, no form, no duplicated rows, no extra items. Do not turn this into a presentation or a phone photographed on a background. It is the mobile app SCREEN ONLY.
Render all Vietnamese text exactly. Crucially, no white cards anywhere in the content area.
